notes: Acceptance criteria for D15-2..D15-G. D15-2 and D15-3 are PASS with committed evidence; D15-4..D15-G remain NOT_RUN until a live candidate exists. No criteria may be marked PASS without committed evidence. D15-2 PASS is FORMAT-LAYER migration evidence only (codec/catalog; no runtime/SessionHandle/lease, no goal/approval/result continuity). D15-3 PASS covers native persistence-layer session resume across a new OS process only, not BYQ runtime-level semantic recovery. Process recovery, original-goal preservation, domain-action at-most-once, approval validity and result traceability remain a required real isolated runtime qualification. R3_RESUME stays NO until D15-G.

substages.name: Native Session Resume Qualification
substages.layer: native persistence seam (isolated, per-generation OS processes)
substages.proves: a new OS process natively reopens the same persisted DSH session through SessionPersistence/SessionHandle/flock/readColdSessionLog with same id and contiguous log
substages.does_not_prove: BYQ runtime-adapter/Gateway/browser process recovery, original-goal preservation, domain-action at-most-once, approval validity or result traceability; the service rows model the fault without running those services
criteria: every failure-matrix row classified as reattached | rehydrated-native | rehydrated-byq-fallback | interrupted
public fresh/reattached/rehydrated/interrupted contract unchanged
internal diagnostic fields are evidence-only and do not leak
DSH session id never becomes BYQ AgentSession identity
native resume failure falls back without fabricating reattach
zero stale lease across adapter/host restart

criterion_results.criterion: every failure-matrix row classified as reattached | rehydrated-native | rehydrated-byq-fallback | interrupted
criterion_results.evidence: native-resume-results.v1.json rows: reattached 3 (browser/frontend/gateway), rehydrated-native 4 (adapter restart, generation replacement, host reboot, executor takeover), interrupted 1 (DSH crash with a lost run), rehydrated-byq-fallback 0 for the eight rows; a native-unavailable control rehydrates via BYQ fallback

criterion_results.criterion: public fresh/reattached/rehydrated/interrupted contract unchanged
criterion_results.evidence: packages/contracts/runtime_continuity.py CONTINUITY_VERSION=runtime-continuity.v1 and STATUSES unchanged; summary.public_contract_unchanged=true; the manifest public_contract matches

criterion_results.criterion: internal diagnostic fields are evidence-only and do not leak
criterion_results.evidence: classifier emits native_resume_used/byq_fallback_used/previous_generation_state/native_session_present in an internal diagnostics dict only; tests assert every decision uses a closed public status and the diagnostics keys are the manifest's internal-only fields

criterion_results.criterion: DSH session id never becomes BYQ AgentSession identity
criterion_results.evidence: classify_generation_transition takes no identity; evidence records native_session_present as a boolean only; no DSH session id is projected as a BYQ identity

criterion_results.criterion: native resume failure falls back without fabricating reattach
criterion_results.evidence: native-unavailable control: an unmaterialized session is invisible to stat/open (native_resume_available=false) and classifies as rehydrated with byq_fallback_used=true; a lost run classifies interrupted, never reattached

criterion_results.criterion: zero stale lease across adapter/host restart
criterion_results.evidence: dsh-crash and host-reboot rows: SIGKILL of the lease holder releases the kernel flock; a new generation opens the same session (lease_released_on_process_death=true); executor-takeover shows SessionAlreadyOwnedError while the old executor lives

substages.name: Real Isolated BYQ Runtime-Continuity Qualification
substages.layer: real isolated BYQ services (Gateway + runtime-adapter candidate + Backend + MCP), scripted keyless provider
substages.proves: across real process/service faults the durable AgentSession survives, the original goal is retained, the durable prompt/idempotency receipts and the domain idempotency receipts deduplicate redelivery, the persistent approval is not bypassed, the result is traceable, and generation replacement / executor takeover behave as contracted
substages.does_not_prove: real-LLM-quality semantic behaviour (the provider is scripted/keyless); D15-4 subagent/fork continuity; D15-5 persistent terminal; host reboot (not executed); production cutover; R3
criteria: an acceptance contract and an independent fail-able observer exist before scenarios run
the observer separates format-valid from qualification-pass: a REQUIRED scenario left NOT_RUN/BLOCKED makes the verdict non-zero while preserving its status and reason
OPTIONAL scenarios are declared separately and do not gate required coverage
allowed/forbidden continuity come only from the trusted contract; an observation that declares them is rejected
PASS requires real PID/generation/epoch relationships and receipt/trace linkage, not field existence or a self-reported fault_applied
the observer fails (non-zero exit) on missing evidence, original-goal drift, duplicate side effect, approval bypass, fabricated continuity and sequence gaps
adapter/DSH process interruption+restart, Gateway disconnect/reconnect, generation replacement and executor takeover are executed against real services
before/after capture records session/goal/approval/action-receipts/result plus adapter pid, generation and executor epoch
durable prompt and domain idempotency receipts deduplicate redelivery with one side effect
the persistent approval is not bypassed and the initiating actor cannot self-approve
internal diagnostic continuity never replaces the public fresh/reattached/rehydrated/interrupted contract
isolated stack uses a dedicated compose project, network, volumes and fresh PostgreSQL; production is untouched
cleanup removes all isolated containers, networks and volumes

substages.name: Subagent/Fork Continuity Qualification
criteria: parent/child durable identity and lineage authorization verified
child session persistence and continuable descriptor verified
cold resume of a continuable child verified
fork lineage distinct from parent; inherited prefix preserved
model/provider, persona, reasoning effort and tool permissions/filter preserved
parent crash, child crash, adapter restart and host restart handled without second persistence

substages.name: Persistent Terminal Qualification
criteria: PTY/process existence separated from attachment existence
I/O rebind separated from stable terminal identity
terminal decoupled from AgentSession lifecycle
BYQ owns TerminalAttachment identity/state/auth/reconnect; DSH owns PTY/shell/I/O
no false reattach after DSH runtime restart or host reboot

substages.name: Architecture Go/No-Go
criteria: capability matrix over D15-2..D15-5 complete
Go/No-Go report committed; No-Go lists exact blockers
Go does not authorize production cutover
R3_RESUME assessed: YES only with completed D15-G and native-continuity evidence
